_about: v28.0 · episode 4 chapter 5 (e4c5), THE HOUSE WITH NINE PRAI: EVERY LINE IT SPEAKS, one row a line.

The source is docs/V28.0-E4C5-PLAN.md (4.0 to 4.9 the first-person parts; 7.3 the fight; 6.1 and 6.2 two more) and docs/V28.0-PHO-LINES.md (Grandmaster Pho's 63, numbered there: `n` here is that number). Chad, 21 Nov 2026 (R14): the decision 'Ok', the lines 'Just do it': they stand as drafted.
THIS FILE IS THE ONE COPY OF THE WORDS. masters/v28.0/assemble.py writes the chapter's SECS, LINES and SAID tables from it (src/chapters/e4/e4c5.js is generated: never edited by hand).

WHY IT IS HERE AND NOT YET IN src/voicelines.js: the registry takes a row only when its take is on disk (chaptertest: a planned row, `est`, is allowed only for a preview chapter, and Chad's rule of v27.0 is that no chapter is ever a preview again). When a line is voiced: its take goes to assets/audio and assets/audio-opus under its key, its row goes into src/voicelines.js (who: the `registry` name of its speaker below), its key into main.js's STING_SAMPLE (and ADULT_TAKES for `he`), and its MEASURED length goes here as `secs` (assemble.py then writes that instead of the provisional one).

A row: key; who (a speaker below); at (where in the chapter: open, walk, devotee, hunt, prepare, fight, bagtied, table, endA to endD, close, card); where (the moment, in words); text (the words exactly as said). Optional: thought (his thought, heard as the man telling the story); draft ('FIGHT-DRAFT': the fight is being redesigned after R14, so these WILL change; not to be voiced until the fight's specification is written); n (its number in docs/V28.0-PHO-LINES.md); same (another key with the same words, for the voice work to share or not); say (what the voice is given where it differs from the text); note; secs (its measured length, once voiced).

PROVISIONAL LENGTHS: until `secs` is given, a line's length is its words / 2.3 seconds (the game's median pace). Nothing is timed to these for good: a film built on them moves when the take is measured (v5.15).

HIS NAME IS WRITTEN Pho AND SAID Puu (Chad, 12 Nov 2026 and R49 of chapter 4): a line that says his name gives the voice 'Puu' in `say`. No line of this chapter says his name aloud as drafted ('Grandmaster.', 'Master.'), so none carries `say` yet: any line added that does must.
A MASTER'S TITLE IS SPOKEN IN FULL (never 'LP'). ANUMODANA is said only by a monk: nobody here says it. No voice names an input ('tap', a key): the brief and the objective line do that, per device.

'Zavier' is spoken aloud for the first time in the game in the fight's lines: how his teacher addresses him, and how it is said, is Chad's to rule before a line is voiced (the plan's 16, 8). It stands on the default: 'Zavier'.
